common_candidate_inputs.DP-01: Committed turn/input fixture supplied by the campaign boundary; no candidate receives committed-turn authority.
common_candidate_inputs.DP-02: One common frozen semantic replay result per comparable substantive operation; authority placement does not create extra inference.
common_candidate_inputs.DP-03: Identical temporal evidence and versions from frozen context fixtures.
common_candidate_inputs.DP-04: Identical context availability and scoped fixture payloads.
common_candidate_inputs.DP-05: Identical UserTask identities and follow-up correlations.
common_candidate_inputs.DP-06: Identical task lifecycle events and fault schedules at a typed fixture boundary.
common_candidate_inputs.DP-07: Identical validated result facts/version and Voice/Text obligations.
common_candidate_inputs.DP-08: Identical device/resource workload and work-conserving fixture scheduling; no resource topology is selected by DP-00 scoring code.
common_candidate_inputs.DP-09: Identical device-family capability/context projections from the frozen QA-06 population.

candidate_visible_rule: Candidate code receives sanitized scenario input only. Keys containing oracle, ground_truth, expected_graph, or injected fault labels are evaluator-only.
oracle_boundary: Oracle files are loaded only by post-execution conformance adapters and never passed to candidate runtime code.

timing_rules.model_call_count_policy: Exactly one frozen substantive semantic sample is used when the path needs semantic inference; authority/component count does not add samples.

determinism.seed_source: SHA-256 of candidate-neutral semantic or case identity
